# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and inspiration platform for ideas across lifestyle, fashion, home, and creative projects, with business tools including Pinterest ads, Pinterest Analytics, and Pinterest Business for brands and creators.

Pinterest combines consumer discovery features like trending boards and curated ideas with professional tools for marketers, including Pinterest Performance+, ad formats, and analytics dashboards. The platform serves both individual users seeking inspiration and businesses looking to reach audiences through visual content and targeted advertising.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest Business
- Pinterest ads
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Performance+
- Pinterest Predicts
- Visual discovery
- Trend forecasting
- Content creation
- Brand awareness
- Digital advertising
- Consumer journey
- Ad formats
- Marketing platform
- Creator resources
- Pins and boards

## Core Discovery & Inspiration

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Main ideas discovery hub with trending content and visual inspiration
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://ie.pinterest.com/today/): Curated daily trends in fashion, beauty, lifestyle and aesthetic content

## Business & Advertising

- [Pinterest Business](https://business.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Business marketing platform with ads, campaigns & tools
- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Analytics dashboard for metrics, insights & pin performance

## Creator Resources

- [Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com/): Creator resources, tools & guides for content creation and audience growth

## Engineering & Careers

- [Engineering | Pinterest Careers](https://engineering.pinterest.com/): Pinterest engineering careers, team info, ML roles & technical blog
